title: IVT-Log-Analyzer Input
description: Access log data for Invalid Traffic analysis and GAB compliance scoring.

requests.description: Array of individual HTTP requests extracted from access logs.

ip.description: IPv4 or IPv6 address of the request origin.

user_agent.description: HTTP User-Agent header value. Empty string is valid (triggers IVT flag).

behavior_flags.description: Pre-computed behavioral and IP signal flags. Known values: 'datacenter', 'hosting', 'vpn', 'proxy', 'tor', 'headless', 'interval_1s', 'interval_<2s', 'interval_exact', 'high_frequency', 'no_referrer', 'cookie_absent', 'js_disabled', 'single_page_session'.
